_comment: What each Zone IS, never what colour it should be (ADR-0020: design owns treatment, the venue owns relationships). Hand-authored curation lives outside grounding.json so a re-harvest onto the classes schema (#26) cannot drop it (#35, #791). Lighthouse Point and Cedar Point Shores are the lake-edge water districts; Frontier Town is the western streetscape; Frontier Trail and Camp Snoopy the wooded connectors and kids' grove; the four Midways and Kiddy Kingdom/Planet Snoopy are classic midway fairways; Professor Delbert's Frontier Fling is the open carnival pad at the peninsula tip.
